summary: v1.4 single-user auth + change-password + auto-backup on logout + widened purchase bill grid – all backend (9/9) and frontend flows verified end-to-end on preview URL. Admin password restored to admin123 before finishing. Previous suites (51 tests in backend_test.py) still green.

minor.issue: No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on current_password – an attacker with a valid access token can brute force the old password. Minor since token is already a bearer. Carry-over: still no lockout on /api/auth/login either.

Writes full JSON synchronously inside the request path – for the 527-party dataset the response was fast (<1s) but as dataset grows this will block the event loop. Consider streaming or offloading to a background task.

Does _restore_all which delete_many({}) + insert_many for every collection with no transaction – a partial failure mid-restore leaves the DB in an inconsistent state. Users collection excluded (good), but no backup of pre-restore state.

issues: Firm name slot shows persisted settings.firm_name ('Galla Bahi' from an earlier test save) instead of the new default '9x Vyapari'. The data-testid app-version-badge below correctly reads '9x Vyapari · Hisab Kitab'. If the intent is to visually re-brand everywhere, the main agent may want to reseed settings.firm_name to '9x Vyapari' on fresh installs or expose a reset-to-default button.

On first paint (~1-2s before /api/backup/files resolves) the 'Folder:' label is empty and the 'Abhi koi auto backup nahi hai' row flashes – a Skeleton or 'Loading...' row would improve perceived performance.

action_items: Optional: show a loading state in AutoBackupList while /api/backup/files is in flight (small UX polish).
Optional: on fresh install, seed settings.firm_name='9x Vyapari' so the sidebar header matches the new branding (currently old 'Galla Bahi' is still in Mongo settings from prior saves).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1600 lines – strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, parties, items, bills, rokad, inward, accounts, journal, reports, backup, settings, import_dbf, gst_returns). Growing monolith makes future diffs painful.
ChangePasswordCard client-side validation (nw.length<4, nw===confirm) duplicates server-side rules. Fine, but keep in sync when backend min_length changes.

Layout.handleLogout fires POST /backup/auto, then logout, then navigate – if backup fails it still logs out (good) but the toast error can be missed because navigation to /login happens immediately. Consider awaiting the toast or delaying navigate(0.5s) so user sees the failure.
AutoBackupList.restoreFile uses window.confirm (native) rather than a shadcn AlertDialog – inconsistent with the rest of the app's styling and not themeable.
